newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed on OTC market.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed on OTC market.

text.p: Following is the closing report for Croatia's over-the-counter market in Varazdin for Friday, October 18.
* Of eleven active stocks, two rose, two fell and six were flat.
* Volume higher at 2,760 units, turnover also up at 128,856 German marks.
* Top gainer was electronic firm Ericsson Tesla, up 20 percent to 60 marks on volume of 139 shares.
* Hotelier Plava Laguna was the biggest loser, falling 6.67 percent to 420 marks with 10 shares sold.
* Croatia Banka was the most active issue, trading flat at 38 marks on volume of 1,982 shares. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
